title: Claude Code command frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a command file (commands/*.md) as Claude Code 2.1.321 reads it (Agent Plugins Extended 1.1.0, section 4.6): the skill fields of section 4.4, except name and paths, which a command ignores whatever their value.
$comment: As for a skill (skill-frontmatter.schema.json): the root accepts any parsed frontmatter, and $defs/effective states the values that take effect.
